baseline_models.mechanism: A future causative showing supplies visible marks in sequence until what was not distinct emerges as truth.

activation_trace.role: Causative showing makes disclosure an act that places evidence before recipients.
The visible mark supplies the units progressively shown.
Emergence and unveiling provide the threshold reached by the showing.
Stable correspondence with reality names what the accumulated disclosure makes clear.

changed_reading.before: A general promise that people will someday notice signs.
changed_reading.after: A directed, cumulative demonstration in which marks are made visible until truth crosses a threshold of distinctness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فِى ٱلْءَافَاقِ وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ ... كُلِّ شَىْءٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: Evidence is distributed across distant limits and the recipients' own identities, then closed under the total class of knowable things.

activation_trace.role: Far sides, limits, and horizons supply the outward field.
The thing's own identity and reality supply the inward field.
Comprehensive inclusion closes the two fields into an exhaustive range.
Anything knowable or reportable is the object over which witnessing ranges.

changed_reading.before: Outer nature and private introspection offer two unrelated kinds of proof.
changed_reading.after: The farthest boundary and one's own identity form complementary evidence-fields with no exempt knowable object.

baseline_models.mechanism: The future recognition of recipients is not what makes the claim true: the Lord's informed testimony is already sufficient and ranges over every object.

activation_trace.role: Doing what closes the need supplies the claim of evidentiary sufficiency.
Lordship and mastery identify the sufficient witness.
Decisive declaration grounded in knowledge makes witnessing evidentiary rather than merely visual.
Total inclusion gives the witness unrestricted scope.
Every knowable object falls within that scope.

changed_reading.before: The promised signs are needed to establish the truth.
changed_reading.after: The signs bring recipients to recognition, while the Lord's all-object testimony is independently and already enough.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah identifies recited, differentiated units as signs while repeatedly locating non-reception in covers, ear-weight, barriers, and inward blindness. The promised showing therefore joins textual signs to horizon/self signs in a disclosure that presses through organized refusal.

activation_trace.role: Visible marks anchor the focus promise in a sign-system.
Unveiling supplies the result that resisted reception has delayed.
Detailing that exposes parts and meanings makes the recited text itself a discriminating field of signs.
Recitation supplies the articulated medium whose truth is tested against other fields.
A protecting cover literalizes the claimed insulation of the heart from the call.
Weight in the ear turns failed hearing into a burdened reception channel.
Prevention of access supplies the interpersonal barrier the disclosure must cross.
Blindness of insight shows that abundant articulation can remain inwardly unread.

structural_cues: 41:3 calls the differentiated textual units signs; 41:44 repeats detailing while repeating ear-weight and blindness.
41:52 immediately poses whether the disputed communication is from God, making the referent of 'it is the truth' plausibly the revealed message or its central claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies articulated signs and recurring reception barriers; I infer that horizon/self disclosure corroborates and penetrates resistance to the revelation. A live alternative is that the pronoun refers more broadly to God or to truth itself, not specifically to the recited message.

changed_reading.before: Unspecified natural signs eventually prove an unspecified proposition.
changed_reading.after: Differentiated revelation converges with outward and embodied marks until even a deliberately occluded recipient is faced with the message's truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The outward field is populated by measured creation, celestial signs, and a visibly repeatable passage from inert earth through water and motion to life. Horizon signs thus demonstrate both ordered origination and the plausibility of renewed life.

activation_trace.role: Distant sides and sky-earth limits provide the field in which ordered processes appear.
Causative showing frames those processes as demonstrations addressed to observers.
Origination supplies the horizon's first causal layer.
Deliberate apportioning turns the inhabited earth into an ordered provision-system.
The explicit designation as signs links celestial cycles directly to the focus promise.
The sun and its light provide a visible horizon-marker while the repeated form denies that the marker is the maker.
Direct sight makes the revival sequence an observable demonstration.
Water delivered by pouring is the supplied cause that activates the dormant field.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life render transition visible.
Earth's life by rain supplies the stated analogue for reviving the dead.

structural_cues: 41:9-12 moves from earth through provisions to ordered heavens; 41:37 names night, day, sun, and moon as signs.
41:39 repeats signs, seeing, earth, water, revived life, and power over every thing in one compact demonstrative sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered creation and an explicit revival analogy; I infer that these are representative contents of the horizons and that repeated terrestrial revival supports the larger claim about renewed life. The horizon field can also include historical events, not only nature.

changed_reading.before: The horizons are static scenery that points abstractly to a creator.
changed_reading.after: Measured cosmic order and repeatedly observed revival form a dynamic outward demonstration of origination, governance, and return.

context_deltas.mechanism: At an earlier 'until' threshold, hearing, sight, and skin testify and are made to speak. The self is therefore not only inspected for signs; its faculties and surface become evidence-bearing witnesses that can address their owner.

activation_trace.role: The persons' own identities anchor the evidentiary turn within rather than outside them.
Knowledge-based testimony names the focus verse's terminal evidentiary function.
Actual testimony by bodily faculties instantiates witnessing inside the person.
The faculty that receives sound becomes an evidence-bearing agent.
The faculty of visual perception becomes testimony rather than a controllable private channel.
The body's covering surface supplies a witness coextensive with embodied action.
Speech given to the skins explains how bodily evidence becomes an articulated deposition.
Comprehensive inclusion extends possible articulation beyond the named organs.
Every knowable thing can be made to bear an intelligible statement.

structural_cues: 41:20 begins with حَتَّىٰ and reaches bodily testimony; 41:53 uses the same threshold construction to reach clarification.
41:22 says the actors did not conceal themselves from their own hearing, sight, and skins.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier threshold where the body testifies and all things can be made to speak; I infer that this is an eschatological completion of signs 'within themselves.' A live alternative keeps the focus promise primarily historical or experiential before judgment.

changed_reading.before: Signs within the self are observations available to private introspection.
changed_reading.after: The embodied self can become an involuntary tribunal whose senses and skin articulate the truth at the disclosure's terminal threshold.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human self repeatedly exposes its contingency through action that returns to itself, endless requests for good, collapse when harm touches it, and bodily turning away after favor. Inner signs are recurrent reactions that disclose dependence while the speaker claims autonomy.

activation_trace.role: What lies in the self as intention and discernment anchors the psychological field.
The self as one's own identity is where the consequence of action accrues.
The human creature is the observable subject whose response-pattern is exposed.
The arrival of an effect supplies the small external contact that reveals the inner state.
Adversity supplies the negative condition under which the concealed posture becomes visible.
The severing of hope marks the first exposed inward extreme.
A second severing of hope intensifies the diagnostic collapse.
Favorable condition supplies the opposite test-state.
Withdrawal by turning the side makes inward refusal bodily visible.
The bodily side supplies the surface on which withdrawal is enacted.

structural_cues: 41:46 balances action for the self against action upon it.
41:49-51 uses repeated conditionals to expose opposite reactions under good and adverse conditions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent condition-response pairs and bodily withdrawal; I infer that their instability is itself a sign of dependence and self-misrecognition. 'Within themselves' can still denote persons collectively rather than an introspective psychology.

changed_reading.before: Inner signs are hidden structures or thoughts one calmly examines.
changed_reading.after: The self is shown to itself through its repeatable swings between demand, possession, withdrawal, and despair, revealing a dependence its speech denies.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fruit emerging from its sheath and a female carrying and giving birth place outward vegetation and inward gestation in parallel under divine knowledge. Hidden development becoming visible supplies a material analogue for signs crossing into clarification.

activation_trace.role: The outward field receives the fruit-and-sheath half of the parallel.
Living persons receive the gestational and embodied half.
Emergence from concealment supplies the shared trajectory toward clarity.
Disclosure to the knower encloses both the unseen hour and the hidden generative processes.
Bringing out of concealment supplies the model's transition from latent to manifest.
Ripe fruit supplies the completed outward result.
The plant's sheath supplies a natural container concealing development.
Hidden pregnancy supplies the inward counterpart to fruit developing in a covering.
The female bearer locates the hidden process in embodied life.
Giving birth supplies the inward process's visible completion.

structural_cues: 41:47 coordinates fruit leaving coverings with every female's bearing and delivery under one knowledge claim.
The paired outward and embodied processes occur immediately before the closing sequence on human response, disputed truth, and signs in horizons and selves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two parallel hidden-to-visible processes; I infer that they model how horizon and self signs become clear. The live alternative is that the pair serves only exhaustive divine knowledge and does not specify the focus promise's sign-content.

changed_reading.before: Outward and inward signs are already exposed objects waiting to be noticed.
changed_reading.after: The fields include concealed maturation whose emergence into fruit or birth enacts the movement from hidden evidence to manifest truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah places doubt about meeting the Lord inside His complete cognitive encompassing of every thing. Witness sufficiency is thus sharpened from reliable testimony to a condition in which doubter, encounter, evidence, and object are all already within the witness's grasp.

activation_trace.role: Closing the evidentiary need anchors the sufficiency claim.
Knowledge-based testimony supplies the epistemic center of the enclosure.
Oscillating doubt identifies the state that persists despite surrounding evidence.
Two parties coming face to face turns abstract doubt into an anticipated encounter.
The same Lord whose testimony suffices is the one to be encountered.
Total inclusion repeats the unrestricted scope from the focus.
Every knowable object remains inside the asserted scope.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and grasp explains why no further witness is needed.

structural_cues: 41:53 and 41:54 repeat 'every thing' while moving from witness to encompassing.
The post-focus ayah embeds doubt about encounter between two emphatic alerts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the immediate witness-to-encompassing progression; I infer that encompassing explains the witness's sufficiency. Encompassing may also carry power and preservation, so the spatial language should not be reduced to geometry.

changed_reading.before: God is a sufficiently reliable observer among possible evidentiary sources.
changed_reading.after: His testimony suffices because every observer, object, hidden process, and eventual encounter is already comprehensively enclosed by His knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links two separated causative showings by rhetorical contrast. It remains anchored in the repeated ر ء ي form and the focus turn toward their own selves, but downstream prose should present it as an echo that redirects blame, not as proof that the two passages are a formal pair.

activation_trace.role: God's causative showing supplies the focus promise.
Their own identities make the promised evidence self-implicating.
The condemned speakers' request to be shown others supplies the externalizing counter-scene.
Departure from guidance identifies the blame assigned to the requested culprits.
Feet literalize the wish to place blame-agents outside and beneath the speakers.

changed_reading.before: God will simply satisfy a demand for visible proof.
changed_reading.after: The divine showing answers a prior demand to see external misleaders by turning the evidentiary field back into the demanders' own selves.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material activation is branch-distant: contextual ٱلْءَافَاقِ and أَنفُسِهِمْ do not lexically mean tanned hide or a dose of tanning. It remains packet-anchored because those exact focus roots carry the hide and tanning branches and the surah makes skins testify. Render only as an image-level analogy of evidence impressed into a surface, never as a proposed translation.

activation_trace.role: Hide at a stage of tanning supplies an outward processed surface.
A small measure of tanning supplies an inwardly named process acting on that surface.
Testimony gives the processed surface an evidentiary function.
The bodily skin is the literal surface that bears witness in the surah.
Its testimony activates the hide-and-processing image as evidence made legible.

changed_reading.before: Signs are detached tokens observed from outside.
changed_reading.after: At the level of material analogy, experience processes outer and bodily surfaces until the trace carried by the skin itself can testify.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the non-dominant ر و ي mapping supplied for focus ر ء ي, so it is deliberately form-distant. The water, stirring, growth, and life sequence keeps it mechanistically anchored, but downstream prose should qualify it as a lexical-image activation rather than claim that سَنُرِيهِمْ means 'we will water them.'

activation_trace.role: Quenching by water recasts showing as supplying what lets a latent sign become manifest.
Visible marks are the growth-like result brought forth.
Delivered water supplies the activating input in the surah's concrete demonstration.
The watered earth's stirring makes formerly latent life perceptible.
Nourishment and growth supply the expansion through which the sign rises into view.
Life returning to earth completes the showing-as-cultivation image.

changed_reading.before: Showing projects already finished evidence before a passive viewer.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory image, showing irrigates a dormant field so that its own signs stir, grow, and become visible.

strongest_changes: The promise joins differentiated revelation to horizon and self evidence in order to breach recurrent perceptual occlusion.
The horizons become measured and dynamic processes, especially the visible revival of earth as an analogue of return.
The self becomes both a repeatable moral diagnostic and an involuntary embodied witness.
The closing move from witness to complete encompassing explains why divine testimony is already sufficient.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet turns one showing-signs-clarity-witness chain into several coexisting mechanisms: textual corroboration, cosmic process, bodily tribunal, affective self-exposure, hidden biological emergence, and total epistemic enclosure. Split and material branches also preserve the more fragile watering and skin-trace images.
remaining_uncertainties: The pronoun in أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ can point to the revelation, its central claim, God, or truth more generally.
The promised showing may span historical, experiential, natural, and eschatological time rather than resolve to one domain.
The tanning and irrigation outliers are image-level activations and should not control lexical translation.
